約書亞樂團
詞曲：林忠竑, 中壢靈糧堂青牧
中譯英：宋怡萌

lines.a: 我渴望與祢更靠近
lines.b: I long to draw closer to You

lines.a: 我的氣息 都屬於祢
lines.b: My every breath belongs to You

lines.a: 祢良善純全的旨意
lines.b: Your good and perfect will

lines.a: 吸引著我 體貼祢心意
lines.b: Calls me to You, to know Your heart

lines.a: 祢那 溫柔無法測透的愛
lines.b: Your love, so gentle unfathomable

lines.a: 陪伴著我 永遠不離開
lines.b: Always with me, Your love never leaves

lines.a: 我願 成為祢可用的器皿
lines.b: I choose to be a vessel in Your hands

lines.a: 因我相信 祢揀選了我
lines.b: Because I believe You have chosen me

lines.a: 傾倒我全所有 一生願為祢而活
lines.b: Pour out all I am for You, I will live this life for You

lines.a: 這世界不能夠 阻擋祢旨意成就
lines.b: Nothing in this world can stand against Your will from being done

lines.a: 祢大能的雙手 必緊緊牽引著我
lines.b: Your mighty hands are my guide, closely leading me along

lines.a: 祢牽引著我
lines.b: You lead me on
